scenario: A line cook was diagnosed with Norovirus. Her vomiting and diarrhea fully resolved on Monday at 8:00 AM. She reports for a food-handling shift on Tuesday at 9:00 AM, which is 25 hours after her symptoms resolved.
policy: A food handler must be excluded from working with or around food if diagnosed with an illness due to Norovirus, and may not return to food-handling duties until more than 48 hours have passed since symptoms (vomiting and diarrhea) resolved.
question: May she work food-handling duties on this Tuesday shift?
